space.$description: Spacing scale on a 4px grid, with half steps at 2px and 6px. Also used for fixed sizes (row heights, icon boxes), as Tailwind does.

0-5.$description: Hairline gaps: chip padding, icon-to-label gap.

1.$description: List item gap, table cell padding-y, tight row gaps.

1-5.$description: Panel header padding-y, small control padding.

3.$description: Default inner padding of panels, code and tables.

4.$description: Card padding-x, indent step, icon box.

6.$description: Media block margin, page top and bottom padding.

7.$description: Row height of trees, tables and nav items.
